description.summary: Advanced pipeline with LLM-enriched documents, testing whether enrichment helps OpenAI's text-embedding-3-small.
description.how_it_works: Before chunking, each document is rewritten by an LLM that adds a title and a summary; the enriched documents are then split into character chunks and embedded with text-embedding-3-small. At query time the Advanced pipeline rewrites the question, retrieves chunks for both the original and rewritten query, and reranks them with the BGE reranker before the chat model answers.
